ESCALATIONS NEEDING HUMAN DECISION (not filed as beads per verify-prompt rules; integration pass owns that):
1. R-07-036/037 (07-transport-app): CoAP Observe overflow policy — spec says evict-oldest, C implements reject-new (deliberate, safer vs subscription thrash). Decide: amend spec to reject-new, or change C.
2. R-07-041 (07-transport-app): spec/07 L737 'CoAP Block-wise (RFC 7959) NOT RECOMMENDED' conflicts with Block2 present in gateway/puck. Decide: amend spec ('except where SCHC reassembly unavailable — OTA/gateway') or schedule Block2 removal.
3. appendix-c-safety F11: does 'all C code in LICHEN' scope include firmware/? If yes, new bead needed for hardening + analyzer coverage.
